sections.heading: Overview

sections.content: The project aims to ensure that portable toilet and shower facilities deployed throughout the State are maintained in a clean, hygienic, safe, and operational condition. The Contractor will provide timely cleaning and pump-out services to support operational readiness and the health and wellbeing of personnel.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
The Contractor shall provide cleaning services for forty-four (44) double portable showers and cleaning and pump-out services for forty-four (44) double portable toilets.
The portable facilities are located at various sites throughout the State and may be relocated as operational requirements change. The Contractor shall provide all labour, equipment, vehicles, materials, consumables, and any other resources necessary to deliver the services.

### Opportunity requirements
**1.**
**RFQ Requirement**
Tenderers must submit their offers via the Coupa RFQ Event.
**Accessing the Coupa RFQ Event**
1. Access the Coupa Public Events page using the following link: [https://supplier.coupahost.com/quotes/public_events?customer=rfsnsw](https://supplier.coupahost.com/quotes/public_events?customer=rfsnsw)
2. Select **"Cleaning Portable Showers and Toilets – Event #762"**.
**Accessing the RFQ Documents**
To access the RFQ documentation:
1. Review and accept the Terms and Conditions.
2. Select **"Enter Response"**.
3. Navigate to the **"Details"** tab, where the RFQ documents are available for download.
**Submission Requirements**
Tenderers must submit their responses through the Coupa RFQ Event. Responses submitted by any other method may not be accepted.
Tenderers are responsible for ensuring their submissions are lodged before the closing date and time specified in the Coupa RFQ Event.
**Response type**
Free text
